import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivDegree

/-!
# Fibre degree over a field

For a divisor family over a field, the dimension in the definition of
`fiberDeg` equals the dimension of the original quotient's global sections.
The residue field of the point of `Spec K` need not be definitionally `K`;
proper-support base change supplies the comparison with its actual scalar
action. This is the field-test degree used in Kleiman, Section 3.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Over a field, passage to the residue-field fibre preserves the dimension
of global sections of a quasi-coherent module with proper support. -/
theorem finrank_fiberSections_eq_finrank_globalSections
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hps : Modules.HasProperSupport p F) (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    (letI := p.fiberSectionsModule t (p.fiberModule t F)
     Module.finrank ((Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).residueField t)
       Γ(p.fiberModule t F, ⊤)) =
      (letI := Module.compHom Γ(F, ⊤)
         ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv ≫ p.appTop).hom
       Module.finrank K Γ(F, ⊤)) := by
  let φ : CommRingCat.of K ⟶ (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).residueField t :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K t.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≫
      (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (CommRingCat.of K) t).inv
  have hφ : Spec.map φ = (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).fromSpecResidueField t := by
    rw [show φ = _ from rfl, Spec.map_comp]
    exact Scheme.Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField _ _
  have sq : IsPullback (p.fiberι t) (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t) p (Spec.map φ) := by
    rw [hφ]
    exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _
  exact finrank_gammaTop_baseChange_of_hasProperSupport
    (Field.toIsField K)
    (Field.toIsField ((Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).residueField t)) sq F hps

namespace DivFamily

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The fibre degree of a field-test divisor is the ground-field dimension
of the actual quotient's global sections. -/
theorem fiberDeg_eq_finrank_globalSections
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {K : Type u} [Field K]
    {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S} (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    x.fiberDeg t =
      (letI := Module.compHom Γ(x.F, ⊤)
         ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv ≫ (pullback.snd π s).appTop).hom
       Module.finrank K Γ(x.F, ⊤)) := by
  letI := x.isFinitePresentation
  exact finrank_fiberSections_eq_finrank_globalSections
    (pullback.snd π s) x.F x.properSupport t

end DivFamily

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
